text:
Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp191-img1.png) to open Lux calculation tool.
![Image p191](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp191-img2.png)
**Calculation name**
Name of the calculation that will be displayed in the Prediction history.
**Resolution**
Prediction raster cell size in meters.
**Light template**
Option to use the parameters from the template if the light misses the required parameters.
**Results:**
- Illuminance, centilux (lx * 100)
